commands: echo 'Downloading ~3.5GB of WoW 3.3.5a client data and importing the AzerothCore schema. First run takes a long while.'
docker compose --profile setup up --abort-on-container-failure --exit-code-from tc9-sql download-miscs tc9-sql

options.command: trap 'docker compose --profile ac down' EXIT INT TERM; docker compose --profile ac up

commands: echo 'Waiting for a worldserver to register with servers-registry (<=600s; AzerothCore map loading is slow)...' && for i in $(seq 1 600); do if [ -n "$(docker compose --profile ac exec -T redis redis-cli --raw KEYS 'ws:*' 2>/dev/null | tr -d '[:space:]')" ]; then echo "worldserver registered after ${i}s"; break; fi; if [ $(( i % 30 )) -eq 0 ]; then echo "--- [${i}s] still waiting ---"; docker compose --profile ac logs --tail=5 gameserver-ac 2>&1 | sed 's/^/  | /'; fi; if [ $i -eq 600 ]; then echo 'FAIL: no worldserver registered in 600s'; docker compose --profile ac logs --tail=80 gameserver-ac servers-registry 2>&1 | sed 's/^/  | /'; exit 1; fi; sleep 1; done
